newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador posts $183 mln trade surplus in September.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador posts $183 mln trade surplus in September.

text.p: Ecuador reported a trade surplus of $183 million for September, up from $25 million deficit in the same month last year, the Central Bank said on Tuesday.
Exports reached $424 million, up from the $350 million in September 1995. Imports fell to $241 million from $375 million.
In the first nine months of 1996, Ecuador had a trade surplus of $1.017 billion, up from $162 million a year earlier.
